RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for  ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the May 16, 2007/Vaisakha 26, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Information and
Broadcasting; Labour and Employment; Parliamentary Affairs; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
184
Incidence of cross-border  intrusion
†*581. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether incidence of cross-border
intrusions by foreign intruders in various
States of the country is on the decline;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the borders of the country which are
highly vulnerable to intrusions and the
reasons therefor; and
(d)  the details of measures taken by
Government to check intrusions?
Uniform criteria for DTH companies
and pay channels
*582. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to
TRAI regulations for CAS, each consumer
must pay a maximum of Rs 5 for every
pay channel, while there is no such
stipulation for DTH, as the regulator
believes competition provides sufficient
price control;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government are taking any
action to provide level playing field and
enforce uniform criteria for the DTH
companies to offer channels as per the
choice of viewers; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Camps for Sri Lankan refugees
*583.  DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the refugees who fled to
Indian refugee camps from Sri Lanka during
the recent encounter between LTTE and
the Sri Lankan Army in  Sri Lanka, are being
taken care of well by Indian Government
through the State;
(b) whether there have been any
instances recently of protest,
demonstrations and road roko by the Sri
Lankan refugees in Ramanathapuram
District in Tamil Nadu against the State
Government, alleging ill-treatment,
corruption, sex insults, etc.; and
(c) if so, the remedial measures taken
and whether they are adequate and
effective?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

State rural road development agency
*584. SHRIMATI  SUPRIYA SULE:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to make the State rural road development
agencies responsible for proper utilization of
funds sanctioned for rural roads under the
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana and
closely monitor the progress of work and
have regular review meetings with the
implementing agencies;
(b) whether till October, 2006 as many
as 57,444 road projects, worth Rs. 34,584.52
crores were sanctioned and Rs. 19,915.69
crores were released; and
(c) if so, what is the total number of
roads covered under this programme?
Cases of attack  on minorities
*585. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that cases of
attack on minorities have been increasing
of late;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken to contain the
same?
Commissioning of SEZs
*586. SHRI MAHMOOD A.
MADANI:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) how many SEZs have been
commissioned so far;
(b) the SEZ-wise details of their export
earnings during the financial year 2006-07,
SEZ-wise;
(c) what was the export earning of the
non-IT SEZs out of this;
(d) what was the annual target for SEZs
for financial year 2006-07; and
(e) what is the export target for the
financial year 2007-08?
Safeguarding the interests of Indian
farmers in ASEAN
*587. DR. ABHISHEK MANU
SINGHVI: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Association of South
East Asian Nations (ASEAN) had attended
to the sensitivities of India during the
negotiations held during January, 2007 in
Philippines, for the proposed Free Trade
Agreement (FTA);
(b) if so, whether India's objective of
forging a consensus with the ASEAN on
the contentious issues of the negative list
of items that we did not want to be
considered, was adequately achieved; and
(c) whether the interests of Indian
farmers and sections of the domestic
industry have been safeguarded?
Performance of Rural Development
Programmes
*588. SHRIMATI  VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the of Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have recently
reviewed the implementation of the Rural
Development Programmes;
(b) if so, whether any shortcomings in
their implementation have been noticed in
Himachal Pradesh; and

186
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) if so, the follow up action taken by
Government for implementation of the
schemes, as per the set guidelines?
Taxes on cement
†*589. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister  of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that tax is
collected by Government on cement and
on the material used for its manufacture in
the country;
(b) if so, the kind  of taxes imposed by
the Central Government and the State
Governments on cement and on the material
used for its manufacture during 2006-07;
(c) the rates of the tax collected by the
Central and the State Governments; and
(d) the amount of all the taxes recovered
per tonne,  as in April, 2007?
Adverse affect of doing away
compulsory package in
sacks of Jute
†*590. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:  W ill the Minister of TEXTILES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry is considering
to do away with the condition of packing
grains, sugar and other materials in the sacks
and sacks made of jute as has been provided
under the Jute Packaging Materials Act,
1987;
(b) whether the jute industry will be
adversely affected as a result thereof;
and
(c) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to save this Industry?
Ban on export of Kabli Channa
*591. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had banned the export of pulses including
Kabli Channa, in June, 2006, which resulted
in substantial crash of the price of Kabli
Channa; if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government lifted that ban on export of
Kabli Channa on February 20, 2007 and
allowed  its  export under specific
permission by Director General of Foreign
Trade; and
(c) if so, what are the names of the
companies, alongwith the quantity of Kabli
Channa exported by each, so far?
SEZs notified by Government
*592. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have notified
83 SEZs, recently;
(b) if so, the names of these SEZs, their
State-wise location and area of land of each;
(c) whether compensation would be
enhanced for these lands acquired from
farmers; and
(d) the steps proposed  to apply latest
relief policy for lands acquired for these 83
SEZs?

187
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Marketing of branded spices
*593. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
market branded spices and value-added
products in the domestic market, through a
separate channel;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
ensure remunerative, stable prices for
farmers and  quality products at reasonable
prices for consumers?
Rehabilitation measures for child
labour
*594. SHRIMATI  SYEDA
ANWARA TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of  LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a)  what  effective and comprehensive
measures have been adopted by
Government after ban on child labour came
into force, to ensure that the rescued children
are properly looked after and given
vocational or any other training so that they
become-self-sufficient in course of time;
(b) what long-term plans for proper
enforcement and rehabilitation have been
drawn by Government, in consultation
with State Governments and NGOs, etc.
in this regard; and
(c) what has been, the financial
implications towards this rehabilitation
programme  during the three months it has
been in existence?
Strengthening SHGs
*595. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:  Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are
strengthening Self Help Groups;
(b) if so, the comparative details thereof
during the last three years;
(c) the role of public and Government
in this regard,  especially in Andhra Pradesh;
and
(d) the present status of Self Help
Groups, as on date, in Andhra Pradesh?
Revamped TUFS
*596. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister  of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the New  Technology
Upgradation Fund Scheme, which is being
revamped, starts from May, 2007;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the major portion of outlay
will be utilized for servicing outstanding
interest subsidy;
(d) if so, whether adequate funds will
be available for new investments;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Weapons seized by security forces
†*597. SHRIMATI  MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that full record is

188
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
not maintained with regard to weapons
seized by the security forces during
operations or those recovered from the
surrendering terrorists in Jammu  &
Kashmir;
(b) whether these weapons are sold
illegally by the security forces to criminals
or anti-social elements; and
(c) the number of such cases surfaced
during the year 2005-06 and the action taken
in such cases alongwith  the number of those
penalized?
Review of CRF/NCCF norms
*598. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL:  Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Twelfth Finance
Commission has notified the Calamity
Relief Fund/National Calamity
Contingency Fund for the period 2005-06
to 2009-10;
(b) whether Government have
constituted an Expert Group to review the
relief norms of CRF/NCCF;
(c) whether the Expert Group has
submitted its report;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the action taken on the
recommendations/suggestions made by the
Expert Group?
Security by Government
†*599. SHRI SURENDRA LATH:  Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of persons in the country
who though not holding any official
positions are being provided security by
Government at present;
(b) the amount being spent by
Government on this security;
(c) whether Government conduct
periodical review for providing such
security; and
(d) if so, in respect of which persons
such reviews were made during the last three
years?
Security to women working in
night shifts
†*600. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL:  Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
contemplated/taken any action to provide
security to women working in night shifts
in multinational companies in private
sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

Space for weavers in SEZs
†4432. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether All India Handloom Board
has requested to reserve some space for
handloom and powerloom weavers in
Special Economic Zones;
(b) if so, whether their demand has been
accepted;
(c) whether any provision has been made
in Special Economic Zones for Vidarbha
region, which is leading in Handlooms and
Powerlooms; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Export of village produced goods
4433. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to push
exports of village produced goods, by grant
of deemed Export Promotion Council status
to the Village Industries Commission, to
ensure all-inclusive growth;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether this initiative would create
employment for lakhs of women and the
rural poor; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Designating special products at Doha
Round
4434. SHRI P.R. RAJAN: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) which farm commodities would be
designated as Special Products in the ongoing
negotiations of the WTO's Doha Round;
and
(b) how would Government respond to
the United States insistence that Special
Products should be limited to "not more than
the tariff lines"?
Export target for 2007-08
4435. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set new
export target for 2007-08;

Fewer ports for Export Promotion
Scheme
4436. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that out of 346
airports, seaports and inland depots in our
country, only 108 ports have been notified
for export promotion schemes; and

for not extending this scheme to all the
ports in the country, to save the freight
cost of large number of exporters?
Help to retailers by foreign companies
in retail sector
†4437. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether at the time of permitting
foreign direct investment in retail market in
the country any stipulation had been made
to the effect that foreign companies would
lend a helping hand in making retailers
financially sound;
(b) if so, in which areas the foreign
companies can extend help to retailers of
the country; and
(c) what effective provisions have been
made to ensure that retailers would not be
affected adversely due to entry of major
industrial houses in the retail business?

retail business

Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND

(a) whether it is a fact that as per an
assessment a turnover of 30 billion dollars
during the next five years of retail business
in the country is expected;
(b) if not, the assessment of
Government in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that about
70 per cent share of total capital investment
in the said sector would be of major Indian
and foreign commercial institutions; if not,
Government's assessment in that regard; and

investment in total retail business of major
Indian and foreign companies, and Indian
small companies?

4439. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
SHRI P.R. RAJAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to bring
uniformity in the level of FDI within various
segments of a particular sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Ministry is proposing to
increase the FDI limit in key areas in
telecom; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

promoters

Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND

(a) whether it is a fact that SEZ

Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Board of
Approval has put on hold the consideration

(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government have decided
to give due consideration to these
proposals; and
(d) if so, the new criteria on which the

Industrial parks in the country

BAL APTE:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:

INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of industrial parks set up

years, State-wise;
(b) whether Government are
contemplating to set up more industrial parks
in the country;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether the industrial parks have lost
their relevance after the launch of new
schemes for industrial development; and
(e) if so, the reaction of Government

Demand and availability

AGGARWAL: W ill the Minister of

(b) the year-wise and State-wise details
the gold imported during the last three years,
till date;
(c) the main reasons for fluctuation in
prices of gold during the recent past; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
control the prices?

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(a) the percentage of trade transacted
by the export-oriented industrial units in
the total import-export trade of the
country during each of the last three years;
(b) the foreign exchange earned by the
same during the said period;
(c) whether several economic
concessions are being provided to the said
units; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
ASIDE Scheme

the Minister of COMMERCE AND

allocated on the basis of growth of export,

current year, and the amount allocated/

Allocation for Special Purpose Tea

(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reason therefor?
Import of American motorbikes

JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND

America have entered into an agreement
recently under which import of American
motorbikes and export of Indian mango has

business sector in Gross Domestic Product
in the country increased during 2000 to
2006 continuously;
(b) if so, the rate of average annual
increase during the above period;

(c) whether the percentage of profit in
the said sector also increased alongwith
expansion of this sector; and
(d) if so, the likely percentage in Average
annual profit likely to increase?
Review of iron ore export policy

BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have, of late,
reviewed and revised the iron ore exports
policy, in view of the latest protests against
iron ore exports;
(b) if so, the outcome thereof; and
(c) what steps are being envisaged to
meet the growing needs of the domestic
steel industry and to keep ore exports in
tune with demands of the domestic steel
industry's growth?
Funds for floriculture export
4450. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set up a
special fund to boost exports of floriculture;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action plan of Government to
develop this sector in Orissa, to improve
its economy?
Flouting ban on pulses by exporters
4451. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
SHRI MAHENDRA SAHNI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in a latest
revelation made in the first week of April,
it came to notice that while exporters were
flouting the ban on pulses, the Commerce
Ministry knew of the precise quantum of
pulse trade but chose not to intervene;
(b) if so, whether its own agency,
Directorate General of Commercial
Intelligence and Statistics said it was
regularly updating the Ministry on pulses
being shipped out during the ban;

(d) what action Government have taken

Reliance during the last three years,

companies for allotment of land, State-wise;

(d) what is the policy of Government
in respect of promoting and protecting the
interests of industries vis-a-vis protecting
the interest of farmers and land owners?

COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Japanese
companies are planning to invest in India;

the Minister of COMMERCE AND

(a) whether it is a fact that Japan is not
importing our mangoes, citing that our
mangoes are not vapour heated;
(b) whether it is also a fact that USA
has also refused to import our mangoes,

(c) if so, whether Government have
decided to set up two vapour heat plants
in Andhra Pradesh; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
No approval to fresh SEZ applications
by BoA
4456. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of COMMERCE

(a) whether the Board of Approvals

any fresh application, other than those
focusing on conversion of in-principle
approval to formal approval in 19 cases;
(b) if so, the reasons for not considering
fresh applications;

Pradesh in the list of 19 SEZ applications;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) for how many SEZs the BoA has
granted formal approval so far and how
many hectares of land would be required
for them?
Achievement of WTO objectives at
Doha

Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have achieved
the prime objectives of the draft Doha
agreement of World Trade Organisation of

(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that many
differences between the Ministry of
Agriculture and Ministry of Commerce have
arisen about the number of products to be
kept in the category of special products, for
providing protection to agro products against
import on cheaper rates under the
Agreement on Agriculture of World Trade
Organisation; and

1035
(d) if so, the details thereof, alongwith
the reasons therefor?
